announcement.quote: These materials are for a Special Meeting of Shareholders (the “Meeting”) of Matthews Asian Growth and Income Fund (the “Target Fund”), a series of Matthews Asia Funds (the “Trust”)

deals.notes: Both funds are series of one mutual fund trust (CIK 923184 is the trust). Acquiring fund is not named in the excerpts; the 2025-01-27 425 caption lists Matthews Asian Growth and Income Fund and Matthews Emerging Markets Equity Fund. Later N-14 filings (2025-09-30, 2026-03-06) show no merger text in their excerpts; 2026 DEFA14As concern a new investment management agreement and quorum, not shown to be a merger.

problems: Only the 2024 merger is described in excerpts. The 2025 and 2026 N-14 filings may propose other mergers but their excerpts do not say.
